summary: Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K attaching an unofficial English translation of a ratings report from S&P Global Ratings Maalot Ltd. The report assigns an ilA rating to the company's proposed issuance of up to NIS 550 million par value of unsecured Series G notes. The proceeds will be used for ongoing operations and refinancing existing debt. This is a routine debt issuance accompanied by a rating report; it does not involve a transformative corporate event. There are no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation elements. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer disclosure.
